column1: # Words Kannada speakers routinely write in Kannada script but which are NOT
# phonetically derivable from the Kannada phonetic rules: English spelling says
# little about English sound, so "school" would come out ಸ್ಚೂಲ್ and "phone"
# ಫೊನೆ. Typed on the Kannada phonetic layout, the English spelling on the left
# resolves directly to the Kannada form on the right, ahead of the rules and of
# the dictionary. Kannada gives some loans a final u (ಕಾರು, ಕಾಲೇಜು); where a
# native word is as common, it follows as a second choice (train ಟ್ರೈನ್, ರೈಲು).
# Spellings are written without ZWNJ (ವೆಬ್ಸೈಟ್, not ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್).
# A hand-written draft that wants a Kannada speaker's review. A wrong entry
# here is worse than a missing one, since it outranks everything.
# Format: english<TAB>kannada   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# Keep the English key lowercase. First column is matched case-insensitively.
